name: Sonara bar
description: A player bar under a tab's terminal: play and pause, a seek slider, the title, and back and skip buttons. A sample with a fake source: it plays nothing, and Claude (or you) tells it what is playing with sonara_now. Open it from a tab's menu.
author: Flare

tools.name: sonara_now
tools.description: Tells the Sonara bar sample what is playing: the title, the position and length in seconds, and whether it plays. The sample plays no sound; it only shows it.

pos.description: The position in seconds, 0 to len.

len.description: The length in seconds, more than 0.
